title: The Siege Of Mallworld
content: For those in the know I hope to hear what your experiences in this realm have been. The dreams began for me quite young. My earliest memories of this place were well into the Web 1 era nearing the dawn of the Web 2 age. The interior resembles a modern Sonic the Hedgehog type of platformer with unparalleled locomotion opportunities if you will. I remember blasting through the synthwave lit arcade-like corridors at lightning fast speeds. The halls blending together in streaks of light as I navigated the winding paths through the space. From the experiences and accounts Ive heard from others whove visited Mallworld the place is basically infinite. Which makes sense though my first experience in Mallworld began to wind down as I made my way through its massive expanse before reaching a sort of hanger bay. I don’t remember how or why I was able to find my way through but somehow I had. My speed thanks to a pair of what I can only describe as rocket powered boots 🥾 (hence the Sonic reference) That allowed me to glide through the air upon my exit from the Mallworld hanger. When I looked back at the structure I had just launched myself out of it reminded me of a massive airship (think Marvel Helicarriers on steroids and super stimpacks with a dash of buffout rushing water and and turbo for good measure) ;~} plummeting to the ground with an odd sense of exhilaration mixed with euphoria and liberation. As though once Id made it out I had achieved a sort of indescribable freedom. That was the first time I recall ever seeing Mallworld. An experience that was so prevalent that I couldn’t stop talking about it with all of my friends at school. Some who had similar experiences shared their stories and dreams others listened with what seemed like confusion or disbelief and others who completely tuned out as I began to detail my experience in that place. Now if this was all there was to it I wouldn’t regard the experience with any importance or great relevancy. Waving it off as a childhood dream; the product of an overacting imagination. Yeahhhh but that wasn’t where it ended. Of course as I fell to the ground the logical conclusion would be that this is where the dream ended or that I hit the ground and that was it or some other arbitrary conclusion. Not in the slightest. Lucid dreaming was very common for me at this age. I can still pull it off today but I’ve taxed my body and mind to such degrees over the years that regaining control of my dreams is no easy feat these days. They were so common that I would often wake up and live half or whole days in a dream in 15 minutes up to an hour of initially waking and subsequently falling back to sleep. Imagine getting a jump start on the day knocking out all of your chores and hopping onto your favorite console of choice only to notice that the gameplay felt slightly off because you suddenly wake up out of nowhere with the first 5 to 10 hours of your day rewinding all the way back to the second time you open your eyes to realize you never even left your bed. Needless to say it took a lot of mastery to discern the difference between the dream world and real world sometimes. All of this only intensified more as the years progressed following my escape from Mallworld. Once I reached the ground I was able to explore a bit there was an open field where I’d landed with a city in the background if memory serves me. I made my way towards the city and that’s when I woke up. I couldn’t believe it though. Unsatisfied with this ending I forced myself back into the dream to explore the city after managing to travel for a few blocks I had awoken again. This time fully alert and awake. Following my first action packed journey through Mallworld I had developed the ability to repopulate into my dreams following my wake from these realms or spaces. This wasn’t crazy to me at the time because I was used to having mind bending dreams. So it made perfect sense that my mind could not only recreate the dreams but that I could continue to explore them as though I had a save data of the dream that could be reloaded at will. Fast forward a decade plus and I find myself in a colosseum or massive amphitheater with an artificial sky surrounded by world leaders famous people and many faces who were unknown to me. A mass of people all intermingled as though it was completely normal. I don’t remember why we were here but it felt like the senate meetings from Star Wars without the Sci fi aspects or at least they weren’t super clear. It felt like something you could see today but wouldn’t due to how the world is run. At any rate there we sat cheering and laughing screaming with glee until suddenly there was a massive ear splitting *CRACK* and the crowd briefly fell silent before erupting in panic. One by one people began to cry scream and run only to slump over due to their excommunication from their bodies if you will. All these years later my pre adolescent naïveté had been shaken and years of superstition indulgence convinced me to get the hell out of dodge ASAP. Sudden I began to see tube-like tunnels spring up from the concrete of the stadiums stands and quickly dove into one. Where I was eventually funneled into my waking body once again. This was the first time I’d felt panic in a dream ever. So I know what it had to be and understood the relevance of this experience. Following this I recall navigating massive cities at a quick pace. Always on some sort of mission. See what I failed to mention earlier is that with my ability to repopulate my dream world’s I voluntarily revisited Mallworld. Years after my initial visit and escape from Mallworld I decided to take the boots for a spin. Ascending from the ground back up above the clouds onto the silver lining accented airship that I knew as Mallworld. Back to the hanger that I once had leapt from down below. Now everything looked different. Off somehow. I have no way to describe it or put any of the latter experience into words yet it unnerved me from the moment I reentered Mallworld. I believe that there are methods for manual navigation of Mallworld. That we can all visit and leave at our leisure only if we are ready. Personally I believe that I had made it back into Mallworld into an important part of the structure but that I can’t continue further as to do so would lead to severe consequences. So I’m electing to go about traversing it in another way. I hope that this post will encourage others to share their experiences here so that we can find those who are laying siege to Mallworld to identify where they are in the Clearspace and progress beyond the hardstop limits that many of us have consistently run into. If you’re up to the task share your experiences and let’s build our way through the mass confusion event that has taken over the space. To continue to expand our understanding of this unique realm. Should the conversation on this topic expand I will share more of my experiences. Thank you
